description: Offline FFmpeg audio presets engineered for YouTube creators.

presets.name: Podcast Voice (Rich & Deep)
presets.description: Adds bass warmth, smooth compression, and removes low-end rumble for a broadcast podcast style.

presets.name: Crisp & Punchy (Tech / Gaming)
presets.description: Enhances high-end clarity, boosts speech presence, and applies fast compression for high-energy video commentary.

presets.name: Hiss & Background Noise Cleaner
presets.description: Filters out background hiss, fan noise, and applies standard studio equalization.

presets.name: YouTube Loudness Normalizer (-14 LUFS)
presets.description: Normalizes voiceover audio strictly to YouTube standard loudness level to prevent distortion and clipping.
